subject: Annual prepay invoicing cadence & collection gateway — OraTech
body_messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@oratech.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: OraTech Billing <billing@oratech.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual prepay — invoicing cadence request

Hi Priya,

Hope you’re well — picking up from our procurement team: OraTech will be moving forward with a 12-month committed prepay (approx. $600k USD annual). Procurement has two asks before we can activate payment:

- A clear invoicing cadence (they prefer a single consolidated invoice monthly tied to a PO)
- Confirmation on VAT treatment for invoices issued by Redwood (we are registered across several EU entities)

I attached our purchase request and a short procurement note. Can you confirm who at Redwood will own the billing cadence and whether you can issue consolidated monthly invoices that map to a single PO? Also will invoices be gross or net of VAT?

Thanks — Elena

[Attachment: OraTech_annual_prepay_request_2027.pdf (PDF)]
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@oratech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — invoicing cadence request

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the attachment. Congratulations on getting procurement aligned. High level answers below, and I’ve copied finance and tax so we can lock details:

1) Invoicing cadence: Redwood can do a single consolidated invoice monthly that references a single PO number. We will produce an invoice on the 1st of each month for the prior month’s drawdown(s).

2) Drawdown model: Customer prepays an annual amount; we deduct usage monthly against that balance. Ledger will show the monthly consumption line items; the monthly consolidated invoice will be the formal tax/billing document.

3) VAT treatment: We need to confirm which OraTech entity will receive the invoices and whether reverse-charge applies. Kimberly — can you advise on the recommended invoice entity and VAT line items for EU-registered customers?

4) Bank remit / billing contact: Elena, if procurement wants a different remit/billing email or bank details, please send the billing contact and any bank forms.

I attached a proposed invoice schedule (simple template) and a suggested mapping for PO -> monthly consolidated invoice. If that works I’ll open the DocuSign SOW and loop in legal.

Next steps:
- Elena: confirm receiving entity + PO number + remit contact
- Kimberly: confirm VAT path (gross vs reverse-charge) and whether we need to issue invoices from Redwood EU entity
- Rishi / Marcus: confirm operational readiness for monthly consolidation and ledger exports to match OraTech AP format (CSV/SEPA fields)

Best,
Priya
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: annual_prepay_schedule_v1.xlsx (Excel)]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@oratech.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — invoicing cadence request

Thanks Priya / Elena — quick VAT notes from finance/tax:

- If OraTech receives invoices from our UK/EU entity and they are VAT-registered, we can issue invoices with VAT charged (gross). Alternatively, if OraTech provides a valid VAT ID for an intra-EU B2B supply, we can zero-rate the VAT and put a reverse-charge note on the invoice.
- We need the exact legal entity to bill (name + registered address + VAT ID).
- For consolidated monthly invoices referencing a single PO: we can include per-line consumption detail (dates & token counts) and a single invoice total. AP typically accepts that.
- Attach list of supporting docs required for procurement (certified invoice PDF, bank remit form if changing payment rails, and SOC2 attestation if requested).

Action items assigned:
- Elena: confirm the OraTech legal invoicing entity + VAT ID and whether they want gross VAT or reverse-charge.
- Priya: once entity confirmed, I’ll prepare the template with the correct tax fields and confirm whether we should issue from Redwood EU or Redwood US entity.
- Marcus / Rishi: confirm the CSV export fields for OraTech AP and whether SEPA-compatible IBAN formatting is required.

Kimberly
Finance — Redwood Inference

[Attachment: oratech_procurement_instructions.pdf (PDF)]
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@oratech.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: OraTech Billing <billing@oratech.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — invoicing cadence request

Priya / Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement confirms: 

- Bill to: OraTech Inc. (NL branch)
- VAT ID: NL123456789B01
- PO: ORA-2027-5512 (this will be a single PO used for the 12-month commitment)
- Remit contact: billing@oratech.com (please update payment email)
- Procurement still prefers consolidated monthly invoices with the detailed consumption lines embedded in the invoice PDF.

Procurement also asked whether the SOW and purchase order can be bundled in a single DocuSign packet so their legal team can sign everything together. They will also need our SOC2 up-to-date cert (they requested a copy).

We are good to proceed once you confirm which Redwood entity will issue the invoice and whether the invoice will carry VAT or be reverse-charge.

Regards,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement, OraTech Inc.

[Attachment: OraTech_PO_ORA-2027-5512.pdf (PDF)]
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@oratech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — invoicing cadence request

Elena — excellent, thanks for the PO and VAT details. Summary and owners below so we can close this out: 

Summary decisions
- Billing entity: Redwood EU (invoices issued from Redwood Inference B.V.) with VAT fields. Because OraTech provided an EU VAT ID, invoices will carry a reverse-charge note (zero-rated). Kimberly will ensure the invoice PDF includes the appropriate language.
- Invoicing cadence: Monthly consolidated invoice on the 1st for the prior month, referencing PO ORA-2027-5512. Invoice will contain per-day consumption lines and the monthly total.
- Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date; payment remit to our usual EU bank (SEPA IBAN). If OraTech changes bank details we will accept the updated remit email but any bank change requires the signed bank-change form.

Owners & next steps
- Kimberly: prepare the invoice template with reverse-charge line and flagged VAT ID fields (due EOD Fri 25 Jun).
- Rishi: confirm ledger export mapping to OraTech CSV template and SEPA IBAN formatting (due Tue 29 Jun).
- Marcus: kick off DocuSign SOW packet and include PO + SOC2 certificate link (DocuSign to OraTech legal) — please use HubSpot record HS-78945 for traceability.
- Priya: I’ll update the billing contact to billing@oratech.com and confirm the first consolidated invoice will be generated 2027-08-01 (covering July consumption).

If that timeline works I’ll mark the deal as invoicing-ready in HubSpot and ship the DocuSign.

Thanks all — assignments noted.

Priya
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

[Inline: Sent from Redwood Console — invoice template draft attached to internal folder]
